{"tool": "write_file", "args": {"content": """"One-time verification for LIFE-203 (run after scripts/merge_duplicates.py).

Checks that:
- every record marked "merged" points at an existing, active, valid-ID kept record;
- every kept (merge target) record has a valid household ID;
- no two active records are duplicates of each other;
- no records were deleted (merged records are still present).
"""

from core.ids import is_valid_household_id
from registry.dedup import find_duplicates
from registry.register import load_households


def main() -> None:
    all_hh = load_households(active_only=False)
    active = load_households(active_only=True)
    by_id = {h.id: h for h in all_hh}
    active_ids = {h.id for h in active}

    merged = [h for h in all_hh if h.status == "merged"]
    print(f"{len(all_hh)} records total, {len(active)} active, {len(merged)} merged")

    targets = set()
    for h in merged:
        assert h.merged_into, f"merged record {h.id} has no merged_into"
        target = by_id.get(h.merged_into)
        assert target is not None, f"merged_into target {h.merged_into} missing"
        assert target.status == "active", f"target {h.merged_into} not active"
        assert is_valid_household_id(target.id), f"kept ID {target.id} not valid"
        targets.add(h.merged_into)
    print(f"all {len(merged)} merged records point at a valid, active kept record")

    for hid in targets:
        assert is_valid_household_id(hid), f"kept ID {hid} not valid"

    dupes = find_duplicates(active)
    assert not dupes, f"active duplicates remain: {dupes}"
    print("no duplicate families among active records")

    # Nothing deleted: every merged record is still present in the registry.
    assert len(merged) + len(active) + len([h for h in all_hh if h.status == "inactive"]) == len(all_hh)
    print("verification passed: nothing deleted, one active record per family, valid kept IDs")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
